source.push_resolution: Use the sole direct parent of the CI-only commit and record it. Reject any CI-only diff outside the two install_paths.
source.dispatch_resolution: The full source_sha input must equal that same direct parent; update the default input if the final source changes. The recorded_candidate_sha identifies the initial reviewed snapshot and is not an automatic push override.
source.test_count_policy: Exactly 6017 total/executed/passed cases for the original 596db0a6 source, with zero skipped, failed, inconclusive or other non-passing counters. Require actual UnitTestResult outcomes and all execution counters. Update expected_total_tests for each final source snapshot; two added cases are anticipated to require 6019 after validation.
source.test_settings: build/ci.runsettings (explicit MaxCpuCount=1 for process-global Avalonia headless initialization)

maintainer_harness.performance_policy: Retain all raw samples, both orders, failures and the A/A control. No numeric regression allowance, cherry-picking, profiler, external timing loop or automatic performance-acceptance claim. Shared-runner timings require review of the raw results.

dotnet.source_global_json_policy: Do not edit tracked global.json. The existing 10.0.100/latestFeature policy selects 10.0.403 from the isolated installation. Verify the actual selected SDK in every exact-revision worktree.

timeouts.timeout_policy: Record partial logs and attempted process-tree/group termination. Abort every later product phase after any timeout, even if cleanup is uncertain. Never overlap the next comparison with a surviving child. The bounded orchestration step ends before the job deadline, leaving always-upload time.

retention.upload: Only immediate files at the explicit root/TRX/comparison upload levels: logs, JSON/JSONL and TRX, plus the immutable runner's exact dotnet-info.txt log. No recursive glob. Never upload Git metadata, CodeGraph indexes, complete worktrees or build trees.
retention.live_timing_output: The unmodified runner writes directly to evidence/timings/<unique-comparison-label>. Direct A/B build logs and raw JSONL are already at the upload location before a process/step timeout; preserving them never depends on a post-subprocess copy or metadata pass. Nested A/B worktrees and build trees do not match the immediate-file upload patterns.
retention.worktrees: Do not delete or recycle an output directory during the job. Hosted VMs are ephemeral; only uploaded evidence survives VM decommissioning.
retention.failures: Keep each failed attempt and its exact command, exit code and logs. The known Linux LeakTests NullReferenceException remains a reported failure; do not filter or skip it.

manual_dispatch_note: GitHub requires workflow_dispatch to exist on the default branch. The codex/verify-perf399-* push trigger works without changing the fork default branch or repository policy.

local_validation.checks: Parse YAML and JSON; compile the embedded orchestration without executing it; exercise its extracted pure TRX-counter validator on synthetic evidence; parse the PowerShell block with the native parser; verify action pins, manifest, bounded step deadlines and immediate-file artifact patterns.
local_validation.known_linter_catalog_mismatch: Unfiltered actionlint 1.7.12 rejects only ubuntu-26.04, which the current official GitHub standard/free runner reference lists without a preview marker. The narrow ignore handles this catalog drift; no workflow-expression or other lint diagnostic is ignored.
local_validation.product_executions: Not run: no local product build, test, NativeAOT publish, benchmark or profiling is authorized by preparation of these two documents.
local_validation.ci_execution: Not run: preparation does not publish a branch, create a PR, dispatch Actions or alter credentials/repository policy.
